source: R32 differential test against the OCaml 4.0.2 devnet endpoint https://devnet-plain-1.gcp.o1test.net/graphql, 2026-10-21 (raw parity report retained privately). Each response is OCaml's as R32 recorded it: the fields R32 lists as differing hold OCaml's values, the others were equal on both nodes. The public key of the omitted-variable case stands in for R32's masked key; OCaml fails before reading it.
